update.adminPrompt: BarSQL needs your password to install the update.

app.welcomeDrop: or drop a SQLite file anywhere in the window

editor.beginTxnHint: Queries on this tab run in it until you commit or roll back

connection.authTokenPlaceholder: Not needed for a local sqld
connection.authTokenHint: From the Turso dashboard or turso db tokens create. A read-only token keeps the server read-only too.
connection.sshUrlHint: The SSH tunnel is for a self-hosted sqld. Turso Cloud needs none.
connection.databaseHintClickHouse: ClickHouse database to connect to. Leave it empty for default.
connection.instanceHint: A named instance, found through the SQL Server Browser in place of the port. Not over an SSH tunnel.
connection.databaseHintSqlServer: Database to connect to. Leave it empty for the login's default.
connection.confirmChangesHint: For production databases: confirms INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL and grid saves before they run.
connection.urlScheme: The database URL must start with libsql://, https://, http://, wss:// or ws://.
connection.sshPortRange: SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
connection.sshKeyRequired: SSH private key file is required.
connection.driverNotInBuild: {{driver}} is not available in this build.

cellViewer.arrayReadOnly: Shown as JSON, so it can't be edited here. Switch to Text to edit the value itself.
cellViewer.arrayError: This doesn't read as an array any more.

jsonViewer.noMatch: // No key or value matches the filter

tips.cursorsNext: Select the word at the caret, then add a cursor at its next occurrence
tips.cursorsAll: Add a cursor at every occurrence of the word or selection
tips.cursorsSkip: Skip the last occurrence added and take the next one
tips.cursorsUndo: Take back the last occurrence added
tips.cursorsEscape: Go back to one cursor. {{alt}}+click adds a cursor anywhere
tips.editorRunSelection: Run the selection, or the statement at the caret when nothing is selected
tips.editorContext: Right-click to run, explain, format, comment and change every occurrence
tips.editorDefinition: Go to definition: an alias or CTE jumps to its declaration, a table opens. Cmd/Ctrl-click works too.
tips.editorParams: Write :name for a value to fill in at run time. BarSQL asks for it and remembers it.
tips.editorPalette: Command palette: every command with its shortcut.
tips.resultsChart: Chart in the results toolbar plots the result as bars or lines. Pick the labels and up to 5 values in the panel beside it.
tips.schemaDiagram: Right-click a schema for its ER diagram, or to compare it with another.

tableView.deletesNotFound: One row to delete wasn't found. It may have been deleted already, or changed since it was loaded.
tableView.deletesNotFound_other: {{count}} rows to delete weren't found. They may have been deleted already, or changed since they were loaded.
tableView.countRowsTooltip: Count the rows the filter lets through

tabs.rollbackDescription_one: This tab has an open transaction. Closing it rolls the transaction back, and the changes made in it are lost.
tabs.rollbackDescription_other: {{count}} tabs have open transactions. Closing them rolls the transactions back, and the changes made in them are lost.
tabs.quitDescription_one: One tab has an open transaction. Quitting rolls it back, and the changes made in it are lost.
tabs.quitDescription_other: {{count}} tabs have open transactions. Quitting rolls them back, and the changes made in them are lost.
tabs.rolledBack_one: The connection closed, so the open transaction in {{tabs}} was rolled back.
tabs.rolledBack_other: The connection closed, so the open transactions in {{count}} tabs were rolled back: {{tabs}}.

toast.exportStopped_one: Export stopped - {{fileName}} holds only the first row
toast.exportStopped_other: Export stopped - {{fileName}} holds only the first {{count}} rows

errors.deleteQueryFailedDetail: The saved query is no longer in the library.
errors.reorderConnectionsFailed: Could not save the connection order
errors.settingsNotSaved: Settings could not be saved: {{error}}. The change lasts until BarSQL quits.
errors.sessionNotSaved: Open tabs could not be saved: {{error}}. BarSQL may not reopen them as they are now.
errors.historyNotSaved: Query history could not be saved: {{error}}. Recent won't list new queries until saving works again.

params.title: Query parameters
params.description: Each value goes into the query as SQL, so put text in quotes: 'Ann'. An empty value runs as NULL.

import.notUtf8: This file isn't UTF-8 text, so characters it can't read will import as �. Save it as UTF-8 and choose it again.
import.mismatch: Values that look like {{kind}} may not load into {{type}}

safety.everyRowDelete: This DELETE has no WHERE clause, so it removes every row of its table.
safety.everyRowUpdate: This UPDATE has no WHERE clause, so it changes every row of its table.
safety.everyRowMany: {{count}} statements have no WHERE clause, so they change every row of their tables.
safety.changesDescription: {{name}} asks before running statements that change data or schema.

chart.title: Chart
chart.tooltip: Show this result as a chart
chart.noNumbers: No numeric columns, so the chart counts rows.
chart.noValues: No row has a value in the picked columns.
chart.nothingToCombine: Each label has one row, so there's nothing to combine
chart.howLabels: Labels: the column along the bottom. Rows that share a label make one bar or point.
chart.howValues: Values: up to 5 numeric columns, each in its own colour.
chart.howAggregate: Sum, Count or Average: how rows that share a label combine.

erDiagram.title: ER diagram · {{schema}}
erDiagram.hint: Drag to pan · {{modifier}}+scroll or pinch to zoom · Double-click a table to open it

schemaDiff.title: Compare schemas
schemaDiff.hint: Pick the schema to bring up to date, then Compare.
schemaDiff.same: The schemas have the same tables and columns.

tooltip.runStatementAtCaret: Run the statement at the caret ({{shortcut}})

about.copyVersion: Copy the version for a bug report

structure.discardDescription_one: One tab has structure changes that weren't applied. They're lost when it closes.
structure.discardDescription_other: {{count}} tabs have structure changes that weren't applied. They're lost when they close.
structure.rebuildWarning: SQLite can't change this in place, so the table is rebuilt and its rows copied over.
structure.notAtomicWarning: This database can't undo schema changes: if a statement fails, the ones before it stay.
structure.stale: The table was changed elsewhere. Reload to see it, which drops your changes here.

problem.duplicateName: Another one already has this name
problem.noColumns: A table needs at least one column
problem.foreignKeyColumnCount: Name as many columns as it references
problem.unsupported: This database can't make this change
